prompt: You run a CDN/edge caching tier built on nginx's proxy_cache in front of your origin app. Two incidents just landed: (1) some logged-in users report seeing another user's personalized data — wrong account name, wrong dashboard — right after a page load, and (2) after a brief origin outage, users kept getting 500 error pages for about an hour even though the origin had recovered within minutes. Here's the nginx edge config that fronts both static public assets and personalized, authenticated pages through the same cache. Review it, find the correctness and security defects, and tell me how you'd fix and verify each one.
